title: Styled blueprint
description: The resolved node tree that carries a screen's placement from design to build. This is the SAME tree renderMock() (scripts/lib/render-mock.mjs) walks to produce the ASCII placement mock, and the same tree shesha-form-edit consumes as its build input — a hand-drawn wireframe can drift from what gets built, this cannot.

screen.description: Human name for the screen, e.g. "Bookings Register".

archetype.description: One of the eight archetypes in shesha-form-edit/references/archetypes.md (table-worklist, record-detail, capture-dialog, standalone-capture, list-card, hub, dashboard, wizard).

theme.description: Design-system theme id whose tokens the resolved styles below were expanded from, e.g. "requirements-studio".

viewport.description: The single pinned viewport this blueprint was authored/measured against, e.g. "1440x900". Never mix viewports within one blueprint.

entity.description: The entity the screen is bound to, resolved live (not guessed) against the backend metadata.

form.description: The Shesha form configuration identity this blueprint builds.

nodes.description: The full container/leaf tree, flattened. A node with no `slot` is a root. renderMock() throws on an empty array rather than rendering an empty frame.

bindings.description: label -> entity property -> component -> datatype, for every bound field on the screen.

assertions.description: The placement contract re-measured by the verification loop (references/verification-loop.md) — split-cell membership, row grouping, nesting depth, tab assignment. No pixel asserts.

dependencies.description: Other blueprints/forms this screen depends on (e.g. a table-worklist's createForm/detailForm), mirroring a flow manifest's `dependencies[]` (shesha-form-edit/assets/archetypes/*.flow.json).

node.description: Unique node name within this blueprint, referenced by other nodes' `slot` and `children[]`.

type.description: Component type. One of the registry's authorable types (shesha-form-edit/assets/registry/registry-0.45.1.json), or a structural pseudo-type such as "dataContext".

role.description: One of the nine roles in shesha-design-system/assets/roles.styles.json.

slot.description: The `node` name of this node's parent. Absent (or null) marks this node as a root.

children.description: Ordered child node names. When present, this order wins over slot-derived order for rendering/build purposes.

style.description: Resolved style per breakpoint — literal values only, never token references (e.g. gap: 24, not gap: "$spacing.6").

overrides.description: Per-node deviations from the role's default style. Each entry MUST carry measurement provenance — an override with no source/evidence is exactly what this design discipline forbids.

content.description: Literal content for a text/label-like leaf node.

columns.description: For a datatable node: the ordered column list, rendered as its header row by renderMock().

addedBy.description: Set to "flow-manifest" when this node was injected by the archetype's flow manifest (Task 9) rather than authored from the design/prompt. renderMock() surfaces this as a "(added by flow)" marker.

resolvedStyle.description: A fully-resolved style block — same shape as one breakpoint entry in shesha-design-system/assets/roles.styles.json, but with every token reference expanded to its literal value.

stylingBox.description: Padding/margin. May be a single `padding` number or per-side paddingTop/Right/Bottom/Left.

prop.description: The style property path being overridden, e.g. "dimensions.width".

source.description: Where this override's value came from — required. E.g. "layout-probe measurement", "source grid-template", "design token override".

evidence.description: The concrete measurement/reference backing this override — required. E.g. a probe file path + rect, a source line, a screenshot region.
